gallery.description: The Warder-Totten House (also known as the Warder Mansion) is located at 2633 16th Street NW in Washington, D.C. It was originally located at 1515 K Street NW, but moved to its present location in 1924. The house was designed by Henry Hobson Richardson and built in 1888. Architect George Oakley Totten Jr. bought the house and reassembled it on 16th Street NW. The building is listed on the National Register of Historic Places and District of Columbia Inventory of Historic Sites. It is also a contributing property to the Meridian Hill Historic District.
